cssText: .emc-label-draggable { pointer-events: all; cursor: grab; user-select: none; touch-action: none; }
.emc-crossfeed-route:hover .emc-crossfeed-arrow, .emc-crossfeed-route.is-picked .emc-crossfeed-arrow { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center center 0px; transform: scale(1.7); }
.emc-control-hit { fill: transparent; stroke: none; pointer-events: all; touch-action: none; }
.emc-control-guide { pointer-events: none; stroke: currentcolor; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-dasharray: 3px, 4px; opacity: 0.28; }
.emc-rotate-guide { pointer-events: none; stroke: rgb(22, 163, 74); opacity: 0.55; stroke-dasharray: 3px, 3px; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }

.emc-multi-area { fill: var(--accent, #2563eb); fill-opacity: 0.1; stroke: var(--accent, #2563eb); stroke-opacity: 0.45; stroke-width: 1.5px; stroke-dasharray: 8px, 6px; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }
.emc-multi-drag-hit { fill: none; stroke: transparent; pointer-events: stroke; cursor: grab; }
.emc-multi-drag-outline { fill: none; stroke: var(--accent, #60a5fa); stroke-width: 1.5px; stroke-opacity: 0; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; pointer-events: none; }
.emc-node.is-merge-target { stroke: rgb(22, 163, 74) !important; stroke-width: 4px !important; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; filter: url("#emc-glow"); }

.emc-map-text-selected { fill: var(--accent, #2563eb); fill-opacity: 0.18; stroke: var(--accent, #2563eb); stroke-opacity: 0.75; stroke-width: 1.5px; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; pointer-events: none; }
.emc-map-text { cursor: grab; font-family: "Inter", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.01em; user-select: none; }
.emc-label-fva { font-size: calc(10.5px * var(--label-scale)); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 650; }
.emc-cell-boundary { vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; cursor: pointer; transition: stroke-width 120ms, opacity 120ms; }
.emc-hit { fill: transparent; stroke: none; pointer-events: all; }

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="emc-map" viewBox="0 0 1464 1093" width="1464" height="1093" role="img" aria-label="Multicell community metabolic map" style="--frame-label-scale:1.438"><style>.stage[data-tool="reaction"] .emc-node[data-node] { cursor: crosshair; }
.emc-selection-box { position: absolute; z-index: 35; pointer-events: none; border: 1.5px dashed var(--accent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent); border-radius: 3px; }
.stage[data-tool="cell"] .emc-geometry-handle, .stage[data-tool="cell"] .emc-cell-boundary, .stage[data-tool="cell"] .emc-cell-plate { cursor: pointer; }
.emc-cell-draw-box { position: absolute; z-index: 35; pointer-events: none; border: 2px solid var(--accent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 9%, transparent); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent); }
.stage[data-tool="compartment"] .emc-geometry-handle, .stage[data-tool="compartment"] .emc-boundary-hit, .stage[data-tool="compartment"] .emc-compartment-space { cursor: pointer; }
.emc-compartment-parent-box { position: absolute; z-index: 30; pointer-events: none; border: 2px dashed var(--accent); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 9999px color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 12%, transparent); opacity: 0.7; }
.emc-compartment-draw-box { position: absolute; z-index: 36; pointer-events: none; border: 2px solid var(--accent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, transparent); }
.emc-map :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
.emc-map { font-family: "Inter", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; --label-scale: 1; --frame-label-scale: 1; }
.emc-frame-label { transform: scale(min(var(--frame-label-scale, 1), var(--fit, 1000))); }
.emc-cell-name { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; }
.emc-comp-text { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; }
.emc-label { pointer-events: none; }
.emc-label-draggable { pointer-events: all; cursor: grab; user-select: none; touch-action: none; }
.emc-label-met { font-size: calc(12.5px * var(--label-scale)); font-weight: 600; }
.emc-label-medium { font-size: calc(15px * var(--label-scale)); font-weight: 700; }
.emc-label-currency { font-size: calc(9.5px * var(--label-scale)); font-weight: 500; opacity: 0.72; }
.emc-label-rxn { font-size: calc(11px * var(--label-scale)); font-weight: 600; opacity: 0.92; }
